subject.title: Feature Request: Add custom client display name for TUI

question: Should OpenClaw expose a user-facing TUI display-name override, and if so should it be CLI-only, persisted config-backed, or auto-derived?
rationale: This adds a public CLI/config-adjacent identity surface and affects Gateway-visible presence metadata, so automation should not choose naming, persistence, or privacy defaults without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add CLI-Only Opt-In Flag
options.body: Add a bounded `openclaw tui --client-name <name>` path for Gateway mode only, keeping the existing default unchanged and avoiding persisted privacy surprises.

options.title: Add Persisted TUI Config
options.body: Add a `tui` config key if maintainers want a stable per-user default, with schema/docs/tests and no upgrade surprise for existing users.

options.title: Defer Or Decline
options.body: Keep `openclaw-tui` as the only TUI label until a broader TUI identity and privacy policy is decided.

recommendation.title: Add CLI-Only Opt-In Flag
recommendation.body: Add a bounded `openclaw tui --client-name <name>` path for Gateway mode only, keeping the existing default unchanged and avoiding persisted privacy surprises.

likelyOwner.reason: The current label traces to the OpenClaw rename commit and the unresolved choice is public CLI/product behavior.
